header.note: Checksums at 0x50 and 0x70 MUST be recomputed after any change (header or payload).

payload.note: Compact JSON (no spaces) at plaintext offset 16, zero padded to offset 0xFA010; binary tail (photos?) follows and must be preserved.

confidence_levels.likely: strong evidence, not tested in game
confidence_levels.guessed: name or magnitude only; needs an in-game experiment

fields.name: User ID (save binding)
fields.description: Compared by the loader with the current user ID; equals the Savedata\<digits> folder name. Changing it rebinds the save (header checksum 0x70 recomputed).

fields.name: Payload length
fields.description: Must equal file size - 0x100.

fields.name: Lap (header copy)
fields.description: Always 1 in all samples; probably MissionData/lap_num.

fields.name: Chapter (header copy)
fields.description: Slot-menu display value; keep in sync when progress is edited.

fields.name: Mission progress (header copy)
fields.description: Equal to main_mission_progress in all 12 user saves.

fields.name: Play time (header copy)
fields.description: Equals total_play_time captured 50-96 ms later. Unit probably microseconds (guess).

fields.name: Save time (Unix, UTC)
fields.description: time() at save; shown in slot menu.

fields.name: Unknown 0x38
fields.description: 0 or 3 in samples; taken from game state.

fields.name: Unknown 0x3C (location/stage id?)
fields.description: 137..322; rises with progress.

fields.name: Unknown 0x40 (u64, date-like)
fields.description: 0 or ~2.0e12; computed from date components in the writer.

fields.name: Unknown 0x48
fields.description: 0, 101, 115 in samples.

fields.name: Encrypted flag / nonce byte
fields.description: Loader decrypts only when non-zero; random-looking non-zero byte otherwise. Keep non-zero.

fields.name: Main mission progress
fields.description: Chapter*1000 + checkpoint (e.g. 9030). Also copied to header 0x20/0x24. Values seen: 7004, 9015-9036, 10022. Do not set arbitrary values: invalid checkpoints may break loading.

fields.name: Lap number
fields.description: Probably NG+ lap counter (exe has Get/SetSaveDataLapNum). All samples = 1, so semantics untested.

fields.name: Last selected lap
fields.description: All samples = 1.

fields.name: Points (senki)
fields.description: Equal to 'sen' in every sample (5865 / 10285 / 49130); likely the shop currency. Set both.

fields.name: Points (sen)
fields.description: Mirror of senki; unclear which one the game displays.

fields.name: Bukun
fields.description: 0 in all samples.

fields.name: Player level
fields.description: 1 in all samples (game has no XP level; unclear).

fields.name: Skill max level
fields.description: 1 in all samples.

fields.name: Total play time
fields.description: Matches header 0x28. Unit probably microseconds (65e9 = 18.1 h for a chapter-9 save): guess.

fields.name: Unlocked amulet slots
fields.description: 1, 2, 4 in samples; amulet_slot has 4 entries.

fields.name: Current film slot
fields.description: 0 or 4 in samples.

fields.name: Item unique-number counter
fields.description: Monotonic counter for new item instances; do not lower it.

fields.name: Endings / clear count
fields.description: 0, 1, 1, 5 in samples (5 in the 100% save).

fields.name: NG+ tutorial complete
fields.description: True in cleared-game saves.

fields.name: Difficulty clear flags
fields.description: 4 entries; meaning of order unknown.

fields.name: Inventory item count
fields.description: Quantity of an owned item. Items are identified by a hashed 'key' (e.g. 185346688); the key->name table is NOT known yet.

fields.name: Inventory item id (hash)
fields.description: Hashed item identifier; low byte is often 0x00 or 0xFF. Read-only until names are mapped.

fields.name: Storage item count
fields.description: Same structure as possession_items (assumed; verify).
